plan.concept: Scaled dot-product attention: Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(d_k)) V, with editable Q, K, V matrices, similarity scores, normalized weights, and output.
plan.computation: compute(s) reads Q (n x d_k), K (m x d_k), V (m x d_v) from controls, forms S = Q K^T, scales by 1/sqrt(d_k) when scaling is on (else 1), applies row-wise softmax to get A, and multiplies A V to get the output. Also returns row sums of A, the weighted-sum reconstruction of each output row, and the variance of a single score under the unit-variance assumption.
plan.visual: Left: heatmap of raw scores S = Q K^T. Middle: heatmap of attention weights A (rows sum to 1). Right: heatmap of output A V with the V matrix shown for reference. Below: a bar chart of one selected query row's weights.
plan.controls: Matrix editors for Q, K, V (with a shared dimension control d_k), a toggle for the 1/sqrt(d_k) scaling, a select for which query row to inspect, and preset buttons for equal scores and a dominant score.
plan.checks: Row sums of A equal 1; output equals the weighted sum of V rows using A; scaling off vs on comparison; softmax shift-invariance; variance of a single dot product equals d_k under the stated assumption.
